summary: C4: sync-pricing systemd timer + CI guard test + runbook
description:
Three-layer pricing-sync safety net from BRD §8 — drift catcher,
CI guard, runbook. Without this, the first slug bump after launch
can take down /api/query (BRD §5.4: computeCost throws on missing
model_pricing row).

Files:
  - deploy/sync-pricing.service (new) — oneshot, User=guru,
    EnvironmentFile=/etc/guru-web.env, ExecStart=/usr/bin/npx tsx
    /srv/guru-web/current/scripts/sync-pricing.ts.
  - deploy/sync-pricing.timer (new) — OnCalendar=daily,
    RandomizedDelaySec=15m, Persistent=true.
  - deploy/README.md — new 'Pricing sync' section: install steps
    (mirroring tailnet-cert-renew install), validation
    (systemctl list-timers), recovery (manual npm run sync-pricing),
    failure surface (journalctl -u sync-pricing).
  - src/__tests__/curated-models.integration.test.ts (new) — for
    each entry in CURATED_MODELS, assert getPricing(modelId,
    new Date()) returns non-null. Skipped locally; runs in CI
    against seeded test DB.
  - CI workflow change — ensure test DB has fresh
    'npm run sync-pricing' run before integration test.

Done when:
  - systemd-analyze verify on the new units passes locally.
  - On VPS, systemctl list-timers shows sync-pricing.timer active.
  - A scheduled run logs '[sync-pricing] done: seeded=N updated=M
    unchanged=K' to journalctl -u sync-pricing.
  - CI fails when CURATED_MODELS gains a value without a
    corresponding model_pricing row.
  - deploy/README.md 'Pricing sync' section is complete enough
    for a fresh operator to install cold.

Tests: CI integration test IS the test. systemd units validated
via systemd-analyze locally + systemctl on VPS. No unit-test
surface for the sync script itself (already covered by
src/__tests__/sync-pricing.test.ts from todo:fbd30eff).

Operator action post-merge: one-time hand-patch on VPS,
mirroring the tailnet-cert-renew install:
  ssh root@guru-web-prod
  SHA=$(ls -1t /srv/guru-web/releases | head -1)
  install -m 0644 /srv/guru-web/releases/$SHA/deploy/sync-pricing.service /etc/systemd/system/
  install -m 0644 /srv/guru-web/releases/$SHA/deploy/sync-pricing.timer   /etc/systemd/system/
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl enable --now sync-pricing.timer

Depends on: C1 (TIER_LIMITS for cap math; FALLBACK_PRICING for
fresh-DB CI), C2 (CURATED_MODELS for the guard test).

resolution.note: Three layers shipped: daily systemd timer (deploy/sync-pricing.{runner.sh,service,timer}) + CI guard (curated-models-coverage.test.ts) + runbook sections. Wrapper script resolves the latest release dir because Next standalone excludes scripts/. CI guard fails the build when a CURATED_MODELS slug lacks a FALLBACK_PRICING entry. systemd-analyze verify clean (warns binary not installed locally — installed by VPS hand-patch per runbook).
